remarks: Desirable upstairs 2BR/2BA condo in the Verano community of La Jolla Colony. Bright and well-maintained with granite countertops, stainless steel appliances, and a combination of tile and laminate flooring throughout. The home also features in-unit laundry and ceiling fans in both bedrooms for added comfort. Private balcony with access from both the living room and primary bedroom overlooks the beautifully landscaped courtyard. Quiet UTC location close to UCSD, shopping, dining, parks, and beaches, with convenient freeway access. Community amenities include a pool, spa, fitness center, recreation room, and two side by side secure underground parking spaces.

Modern luxury meets iconic mid-century architecture in this beautifully renovated 3-bedroom, 3-bath Sandpiper residence, tucked within the exclusive Circle 17 enclave. Offering 2,372 square feet, the home pairs contemporary finishes with the effortless indoor-outdoor lifestyle that defines Palm Desert living.Soaring ceilings, dual-pane windows, and walls of sliding glass create an open, light-filled floor plan. The living room is anchored by a sleek linear fireplace with a custom hearth and striking wood-slat media wall, while the kitchen has been thoughtfully remodeled with custom cabinetry, quartz countertops, designer tile, a large island, and high-end stainless steel appliances. The kitchen, dining area, living room, and outdoor patios flow naturally together, creating an inviting space for everyday living and entertaining.The floor plan includes two spacious primary suites with en-suite baths, along with a guest bedroom served by a flexible third bath that functions as either an en suite or guest bath. All three bathrooms feature walk-in showers, and each bedroom offers generous closet space.Oversized 24-by-36-inch tile extends throughout the main living areas and continues onto the patios, creating a seamless transition to the outdoors, while plush carpeting adds warmth and comfort in the bedrooms.The private front courtyard is designed for relaxing with a fire table and adjustable shade coverings. At the rear of the home, the spacious patio enjoys views across the greenbelt, community pool, and surrounding mountains.A private two-car garage, located immediately adjacent to the residence, is a rare and highly desirable Sandpiper amenity.Circle 17 is an intimate enclave of just eight homes arranged around a beautifully landscaped pool, offering an exceptional sense of privacy and tranquility. This residence is situated slightly farther from the road than many Sandpiper homes, creating an especially quiet setting just off Painters Path, while remaining close to the boutiques, galleries, restaurants, museum, and hiking trails near El Paseo.Two HVAC systems, both replaced approximately four years ago, provide year-round comfort and efficiency.

Charming California bungalow tucked into one of Los Feliz's most sought-after residential pockets, just moments from the Village, Griffith Park trails, and neighborhood cafes and shops. This 2-bed, 2-bath home blends timeless character with serene indoor-outdoor living. The main living spaces include a warm and inviting living room with fireplace, a charming formal dining room, and a bright kitchen with breakfast area perfect for casual mornings or entertaining. Original details throughout lend authentic charm and architectural warmth. Outside, lush, tranquil gardens with mature camellia bushes and layered plantings create a private sanctuary ideal for dining al fresco, relaxing, or hosting friends. Whether enjoying quiet mornings in the garden or cozy evenings by the fire, this special home offers a rare blend of charm, comfort, and the best of Los Feliz living.

Handyman fixer on 3.4 acres. The home has great potential with 3 bedrooms and 2 baths, enclosed patio, covered porch deck, covered back patio deck, storage sheds, one car garage, fenced side yard for pets, and plenty of space for your trucks and more.

Step into soaring vaulted ceilings in the heart of Downtown San Diego—this is loft living at its most dramatic. Sun, space, and architectural scale you simply can't find in a standard unit. The generous footprint already lives like a two-bedroom, true to authentic loft style with no legally defined bedrooms. A blank canvas awaiting a full renovation, priced for the right buyer to craft a showpiece in one of San Diego's most electric, walkable neighborhoods. Vision meets opportunity. Bring yours.

Welcome to Villa Mira, where comfort, style, and convenience come together in one of the community's most desirable upper-level residences. Perfectly situated with abundant guest parking nearby, this beautifully updated three-bedroom, two-bath home offers an exceptional blend of privacy, natural light, and effortless indoor-outdoor living. From the moment you arrive, you'll appreciate the inviting outdoor spaces designed to embrace Southern California living. Enjoy your morning coffee on the welcoming front porch, unwind on the expansive wrap-around balcony accessible from both the living room and the primary suite, or take advantage of the private patio just off the kitchen, complete with a full-size laundry closet. Inside, soaring vaulted ceilings and rich hardwood flooring create a bright, open atmosphere enhanced by an abundance of natural light. The thoughtfully updated kitchen with new countertops serves as the heart of the home, featuring custom cabinetry with glass-front accents, granite countertops, recessed lighting, a spacious walk-in pantry, and a full suite of newer appliances, including the refrigerator, washer/dryer, and dishwasher. The spacious primary suite offers direct balcony access, creating a peaceful retreat, while two additional bedrooms provide flexibility for guests, a home office, or growing families. Additional upgrades include a newer HVAC system, Nest thermostat, Ring Doorbell, and fresh interior finishes throughout. Both bathrooms have been updated bringing that modern touch and feel you have been looking for. The detached one-car garage is conveniently located just steps from the residence, with residents eligible to apply for up to two additional parking permits. Villa Mira residents enjoy access to two resort-style pools and spas, a clubhouse perfect for entertaining, beautifully maintained grounds, and HOA dues that include trash service. Ideally located near shopping, dining, parks, and major commuter routes, this turnkey home offers an exceptional opportunity to enjoy the best of low-maintenance Southern California living.
